einzeiler: Analysis of the GOP midterm convention in Dallas and an interview with Steve Hilton.
kurzfassung: Jon and Dan break down the most notable moments from the GOP midterm convention in Dallas, including Donald Trump's financial proposal and speeches by various politicians. The hosts discuss JD Vance previewing his presidential campaign and controversial remarks from Mike Rogers and Ted Cruz. Additionally, Lovett interviews Steve Hilton, the Republican nominee for California governor, about Trump and the state's housing crisis.
stichpunkte: Donald Trump's proposal of a financial check for American adults contingent on congressional control
JD Vance previewing his presidential campaign at the GOP convention
Remarks by Mike Rogers and Ted Cruz invoking the 25th anniversary of 9/11
A surprise video appearance by Democratic Senator John Fetterman
An interview with Steve Hilton regarding his relationship with Trump and California's housing crisis
beschreibung:
At the GOP midterm convention in Dallas, Donald Trump promises that he'll give every American adult a $5,000 check if — and only if — Republicans retain control of the Senate and House, a plan so absurd that even his own defenders can't explain it.
Jon and Dan process the most ridiculous moments from the 18 hours of speeches, including JD Vance previewing his presidential campaign, Mike Rogers and Ted Cruz using the 25th anniversary of 9/11 to paint Democrats as terrorist sympathizers, and Democratic Senator John Fetterman's surprise video appearance.
Then, to cap off a Republican-filled episode, Lovett talks to Steve Hilton, the Republican nominee for California governor, about his relationship with Trump and what it'll take to tackle California's housing crisis.
